scrape-formats.screenshot.evidence: Implemented at ba5bdedf (branch claude/m2-formats on origin/main 914005c): formats 'screenshot' / { type: 'screenshot', quality, viewport } on scrape, batch, crawl, MCP and /fc; the request runs on the local browser rung alone and is refused by name where none is permitted. Live at ba5bdedf through the local API with debug true, HTTPS_PROXY 127.0.0.1:7890 (proxyUsed operator): S1 https://ourworldindata.org/grapher/co-emissions-per-capita?tab=table (test set #24) with viewport 1280x800 answered success on browser_local in 2,490 ms, channelsTried ['browser_local'], a PNG whose IHDR says 1280x800, 110,844 bytes equal to screenshot.bytes, sha256 of the decoded bytes equal to screenshot.sha256, 649 distinct sampled pixel values (not blank), screenshot_captured with the same size, the Markdown with 232 table rows; S3 https://www.energy-charts.info/?l=en&c=DE (#28) the same shape in 6,018 ms, 1,049 distinct values. Loopback fixtures: C3 quality 60 gives image/jpeg starting FF D8 (34,036 bytes); C4 viewport 800x600 gives an 800x600 PNG with screenshot_viewport in the trace and the declared desktop identity on the wire; C5 a 404 page is failed/http_error with its capture kept as evidence; C6 fastMode beside the format is HTTP 400 'screenshot requires the browser lane, which fastMode declines'. Tests: contracts api.test.ts, api app.test.ts (browser-only selection, the http-only refusal), bench pageOptions.test.ts on real Chromium.
